consequence.statement: A new optional setting; existing behavior (first suitable address per device) continues unless the value is set.

assertion.statement: New Helm value nodePort.addresses lets operators configure which IP addresses expose NodePort services, instead of only the first (preferably private) IPv4/IPv6 address of each device.
